answers.how: The person moves approximately 27 px from 1–2 s, versus 107 px for the boat. Scaling by 4 m/s and correcting for their camera distances gives 1.04 m/s.
The boat measures approximately 275 px along its length. Its 107 px displacement in one second corresponds to 4 m, giving a length of 10.3 m.
The boat’s maximum hull width is approximately 55 px. Using the boat-motion scale of 4 m per 107 px gives 2.06 m.
The eagle measures approximately 20 px from head to tail. Applying the boat-motion scale and the eagle-to-boat depth correction gives 0.76 m.
The fully spread wings measure approximately 41 px tip to tip. Applying the boat-motion scale and correcting for camera distance gives 1.53 m.
The eagle moves approximately 307 px from 1–2 s, compared with 107 px for the boat. Scaling by 4 m/s and correcting for camera distance gives 11.5 m/s.
